da-non-sequitur.evidence: [first real review 2026-11-21; no hashed entry existed] Each identity follows by direct substitution p -> p.comp(-X): bar X = -X, bar is additive, multiplicative and involutive (via (-X).comp(-X) = X and associativity of comp), bar X^n = (-1)^n X^n by induction, natural-number scalars are fixed, and any polynomial in even powers with constant coefficients is fixed. I checked each step and they are correct. Minor: the theorem's closing sentence calls the bar-symmetry of three even truncated polynomials 'the categorical-derivation unification at the truncated-polynomial level'. That is interpretation; mathematically it only says the three polynomials are even.
